title: The Message in the Bark
text: Words cut into a tree trunk in your House's tongue, the letters deep and ragged, cut with a knife held in a shaking hand: STILL ALIVE. GOING NORTH. HURRY. The sap has wept over the cuts and hardened, amber in the cold.

outcomes.text: North, at a hard pace, reading every tree you pass.

options.label: The wisest reads the cuts for how long ago.

outcomes.text: Three days. And they were bleeding when they cut it.
WE ARE COMING. For them, if they come back this way.
